    SELECT rm.modelseriesval,
           COUNT(DISTINCT rm.botdetreg) as num_robots,
           AVG(ro.progcyclecount) as avg_cycle_count,
           AVG(ro.cycletimesecval) as avg_cycle_time,
           AVG(prog_counts.num_programs) as avg_programs_per_robot
    FROM robot_model rm
    JOIN robot_ops ro ON ro.operbotdetref = rm.botdetreg
    JOIN (
        SELECT operbotdetref, COUNT(DISTINCT currprogval) as num_programs
        FROM operation GROUP BY operbotdetref
    ) prog_counts ON prog_counts.operbotdetref = rm.botdetreg
    GROUP BY rm.modelseriesval
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT rm.botdetreg) >= 3
),

    SELECT DISTINCT ON (rm2.modelseriesval) rm2.modelseriesval, ro2.currprogval as most_efficient_program

-- Check range of cycletimesecval
SELECT MIN(cycletimesecval), MAX(cycletimesecval), AVG(cycletimesecval) FROM operation;

-- Check how many robots have cycletimesecval < 100 AND progcyclecount > 500000
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM operation WHERE cycletimesecval < 100 AND progcyclecount > 500000;

-- Rebuild with OCE = cycletimesecval
-- Underperforming: cycletimesecval < 100 AND progcyclecount > 500000
-- Enough robots: >= 5 per model series
-- Sort by best cycle activity (highest progcyclecount)
-- Show only top 1

WITH robot_ops AS (
    SELECT rd.botdetreg, rd.modelseriesval, o.currprogval, o.progcyclecount, o.cycletimesecval as oce
    FROM robot_details rd
    JOIN operation o ON o.operbotdetref = rd.botdetreg
),
robot_program_counts AS (
    SELECT operbotdetref, COUNT(DISTINCT currprogval) as num_programs
    FROM operation GROUP BY operbotdetref
),
model_agg AS (
    SELECT ro.modelseriesval,
           COUNT(DISTINCT ro.botdetreg) as num_robots,
           AVG(ro.progcyclecount) as avg_cycle_count,
           AVG(ro.oce) as avg_oce,
           AVG(rpc.num_programs) as avg_programs
    FROM robot_ops ro
    JOIN robot_program_counts rpc ON rpc.operbotdetref = ro.botdetreg
    GROUP BY ro.modelseriesval
    HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ro.botdetreg) >= 5
),
top_model AS (
    SELECT modelseriesval, num_robots, avg_cycle_count, avg_oce, avg_programs
    FROM model_agg
    ORDER BY avg_cycle_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
most_eff_prog AS (
    -- Most efficient = lowest cycle time (best performance)
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (ro.modelseriesval) ro.modelseriesval, ro.currprogval as most_efficient_program
    FROM robot_ops ro
    ORDER BY ro.modelseriesval, ro.oce ASC NULLS FIRST
),
underperf AS (
    SELECT ro.modelseriesval, 
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ro.oce < 100 AND ro.progcyclecount > 500000) as underperforming_count
    FROM robot_ops ro
    GROUP BY ro.modelseriesval
)
SELECT tm.modelseriesval,
       tm.num_robots,
       ROUND(tm.avg_cycle_count::numeric, 2) as avg_cycle_activity,
       ROUND(tm.avg_programs::numeric, 2) as avg_programs_per_robot,
       json_build_object(
           'most_efficient_program', mp.most_efficient_program,
           'average_oce', ROUND(tm.avg_oce::numeric, 4)
       ) as efficiency_json,
       up.underperforming_count
FROM top_model tm
JOIN most_eff_prog mp ON mp.modelseriesval = tm.modelseriesval
JOIN underperf up ON up.modelseriesval = tm.modelseriesval;
